content_of_post_to_comment: I live a quiet life. Staying inside for days. No plans. No people. No drama. No nothing. Just chilling alone. Reading. Meditating. Listening to some Bach. Watching documentaries on bees. Exploring ancient civilizations. Writing essays. Walking. Snacking. Napping. Thinking about life and all. A simple peaceful life.
comment: The interesting tension here is that solitude can be a refuge, but it can also become a way of avoiding the unpredictability that makes life feel alive. I wonder where the line is between chosen simplicity and comfortable retreat.
